sections.evaluation_comments:
10/20/2026
Easily leashed with slip lead. Soft body, calm demeanor. Allows all pets and handling. Easily administered fluid treatment with no restraint needed.
10/19/2026
k9 laying down at front portion of kennel, verbally coaxed k9 to rise. Handler was able to enter kennel with k9. K9 presented with soft wiggly body, seeking attention, with fast tail wags. K9 allowed all petting and handling. Handler was able to exit out of k9 kennel without issue; k9 seeked more petting from handler before handler left building.
10/16/2026
Easy to leash and pull from kennel. Walked with no pull to the yard, walked around, sniffed, and solicited pets. Allowed all petting, but whined when pet in some areas. Dog did not show interest in other dogs when walking back to kennel. Easy to return and remove leash.
10/11/2026
Easy to pull from kennel, Easy to return to kennel, Not interested in treats, Easy/Loose Leash, Calm, Ignored dogs when walking past kennels, Mrs. Cleats greeted me with some buffs then was happy to exit her kennel. In the yard, she spent much of her time exploring but came to me each time I called for her. She benefited from calm, polite interactions.
10/8/2026
Dog was lying down in kennel while trembling body.  Opened kennel door & spoke softly to dog while placing leash.  Slowly stood up & walked out of kennel with verbal coaxing.  Would stop to sniff along walkway to small PY.  Would stay next to handler for a few minutes while panting, looking around surroundings.  Allowed petting on side of body without issues.  Would shift head to side when being pet on head but would tolerate petting.  Explored PY while sniffing nose to ground.  Not interested in treats or toys.  Would approach handler on own & when called over.  Would start to pant heavy while having mouth wide open, leaning into handler while being pet on side of body.  Picked up leash & walked back to kennel slowly while sniffing nose to ground.  Would not enter into kennel on own, handler would fully step into kennel for dog to follow.  Allowed leash removal to be done by hand without issues.
*Based on intake & previous evaluation, placing OLDER CHILDREN 12+ as a REQUIREMENT.
**Interested parties should be made aware of all medical notes.
*Interested parties should be counseled on providing this dog with proper decompression time in a new home.  Allowing time to adjust is important for their comfort and well-being.  Adopters should be counseled on proper dog-to-dog introductions, which should only occur after the dog has fully decompressed.
10/7/2026
At front of kennel with tense body, stoic, stopped eating with some hard stares towards handler, lowered head and quick low growl, settled when leash was presented. Easy leash placement at front of kennel, exited with easy/slow leash pull behind handler all the way to small play yard, startled by reactive dogs in passing, tail tucked, wide eyed, some stop n go to sniff. In yard dog skin crawled when brushing leash on back, would spend most of evaluation sniffing intensely around yard with tail tucked and tense body, slowly explored around yard, would tolerate petting on back when near handler but did not solicit attentions, no interest in treats offered or tossed near. Distant from handler for majority of evaluation, no interest in dogs/staff walking passed yard, continued to sniff intensely until end of evaluation dog approached handler with tucked slow wagging tail, heavy wide mouth panting, wide eyed, lowered head and accepted pets on head, would sit next to handler panting and scanning environment, little eye contact with handler. Slowly followed handler to exit, slow and easy leash pull behind handler back to kennel, walked into kennel on own, able to slowly remove leash by hand with no issues.
10/4/2026
Requesting full evaluation based on field/activity notes.
10/3/2026
Came up to K9 barking and snarling. K9 stood its ground and hard stare as ACO got close to K9. K9 continue to growled and bark. Did not allow easy leash placement; jumped and thrashed when leash was place and was able to slip out. Attempted to leash K9 again and K9 thrashed slightly on the leash. Did not want to walk to truck, so ACO used light leash pressure to motivate K9 to walk. Allowed petting on body and allowed to be pick up, with no restraint, and place into truck kennel.
Growled at ACO when opening truck kennel. Growled when checking for a microchip
10/3/2026
Walked onto ramp on leash, soft body, wagging tail, tolerated vaccines with light restraint, walked to kennel on leash

Would pace along fence line in main PY while keeping tail flagged & panting heavy.  Approached handler, jumping up & nipping @ handlers sleeves.  Able to step to the side & direct dog off without issues while scattering treats.  Handler sat on bench, dog would approach handler, leaning in for petting then return to exploring while having tail still flagged & panting heavy.  Tossed toys, was not interested in toys.  Dog would approach handler again, would lean into handlers legs while being pet on head, turned & started to air snap towards hands, not making contact.  Handler picked up leash, dog would start to bite while pulling back on leash, handler dropped leash, dog would start to pace having mouth wide open & tongue hanging out. 10/17/2026

Easy to leash, hard pull to yard but able to direct when needed, hackles raised and stiff wagging tail when walking past kenneled dogs, no attempts to interact. Affiliative with handler, wiggly body and wagging tail, front paws on lap soliciting attention, allowed petting all over, jumpy when offered treats but sat when given verbal cue, eagerly took from hand. Explored yard, nose to ground, tense with flagged tail when exploring near kenneled dogs on opposite side of fence, returned to handler when verbally coaxed, jumped on bench and lied down next to handler, body soft and wiggly, panting, tongue lolled, allowed more pets, stood on handler's lap and leaned into handler, attempted to lick face. Resisted entering kennel, pulled back and briefly flailed, handler tossed hot dogs in kennel, dog followed, returned to kennel door and allowed handler to remove leash by hand.
10/16/2026
Dog was closed outside for cleaning, standing at gate with soft face and wiggly body language. Accepted treats. Easy to leash. Exited with light pull, appeared interested in neighboring dogs and wagged tail while sniffing towards them. While passing other kennels, dog had raised hackles, appeared more cautious but continued with verbal coaxing. Dog occasionally pulled towards reactive dogs but was easy to redirect with light leash guidance. Dog walked with moderate pull, followed handler into main play yard. Dog drank from pool, followed handler around yard. Tried getting into handler's lap, able to be directed back down. After a few more minutes, dog returned to handler on bench, appeared excited, tried getting into lap again, became slightly mouthy towards arms and hands, more difficult to redirect this time. Handler took leash, straight-armed dog away, stood. Dog wagged tail, allowed petting. Moderate pull on return to kennel. Hackles raised, slight tense body while passing neighbors. Dog would not enter outside portion of kennel, began thrashing head, pulling away on leash. No interest in treats tossed inside. Handler walked dog away, was able to lead dog inside kennel wing while other dogs were closed out. Dog would not enter kennel, pulled back. Handler opened divider, led dog back towards kennel. Dog stood and looked outside for a moment, then stepped in. Handler closed gate, removed leash via clip lead. Dog watched handler with soft face, wagging tail. Accepted treats through gate.
10/15/2026

Soft wiggly body sitting at front of kennel with tail wagging. Soliciting attentions with handler. Demand barked as handler walked away from kennel.

sections.evaluation_comments:
10/21/2026
Handler approached kennel front, dog was closed mouth panting with dilated pupils, standing up with front paws on gate. Handler was able to drape leash overhead and secure without issue. Once leash was secure handler guided dog out to PY, dog pulled very strongly. Handler released dog once in PY, dog sniffed around and handler sat on bench. Dog urinated and then approached handler. Handler pet dog, dog solicited and then attempted to jump up towards handler's face. Handler was able to stop dog with hand on dog's chest and guide off. Dog then walked away and returned. Handler tried consent check-ins and dog allowed petting with short breaks where he would again solicit by rubbing on handler's leg, dog again jumped at handler's face. When handler went to guide dog off, dog briefly mouthed at handler's arm. Handler picked up leash and walked dog around yard, dog continued to glance up at handler with dilated pupils and lip licking. Dog defecated, handler did not clean up immediately due to dog jumping up at handler previously. Handler continued to walk dog around and attempt to deescalate. Dog appears to be easily over aroused. Handler guided dog back to kennel after about 5-10 minutes. Dog entered kennel without issue, when handler reached to remove leash dog's pupils again dilated and dog began lip licking intensely. Handler used leash removal tool and was able to guide dog onto gate. Handler was able to guide leash off, but dog began chewing on leash as handler was removing. Handler knocked on kennel gate and dog released, handler was able to retrieve leash. Handler secured gate and then left small jackpot in kennel and left.
10/20/2026
During AM rounds canine was observed to be excessivley panting, trembling, and not able to settle in kennel.
10/11/2026
Dog was kenneled outside for AM cleaning, laying down, panting, handler tossed treats but dog showed no interest, did not move as handler opened door, lip licked as they held out leash but tolerated leash draped over head and walked out of kennel, strong pull to yard, dog immediately stopped to urinate for prolonged time, likely potty trained, dog defecated, following handler as they cleaned, neutral body and softly wagging tail, allowed petting. Handler sat on bench and dog jumped up and sat on bench next to them, standing on their lap and attempting to lick handlers face, allowed all petting, soft body, eventually jumped down and explored yard. Handler picked up a ball, dog excitedly chased after it, would return to handler and drop it in front of them. Played fetch for a few minutes, dog dropped ball for handler every time without prompting, could be lured into "sit" with toy but showed no interest in treats. Watched a dog walk by yard, remained neutral, reengaged with handler once dog walked away. Handler picked up leash, walked dog out of yard, strong pull again, hesitated to enter kennel but then walked in with no issues, tried to step out but handler blocked with door, removed leash by hand, dog stayed neutral, lightly panting.
Dog has demonstrated escape-oriented behaviors in previous care and should be supervised at all times when around open doors to home, yard gates etc.
"Older Children 12+" requirement due to history of guarding space in previous home.
10/9/2026
Dog was laying at front of kennel, tense, dilated pupils, shaking, panting with v shape commissure. No response to handler or treats, requesting full evaluation
10/8/2026
Didn't engage much in room with handler. Upset and pacing, listening at door once his owners left. Focused on door, able to vaccinate with minimal restraint as he was so distracted. Very strong. Pulls hard on leash when walking to kennel. Pulled somewhat toward barking dogs but no fence fighting. Able to remove leash without issue.
